name: Reasoning Gym baseline-first pivot and smoke
purpose: Pivot the program to build and test Reasoning Gym baselines before further method evaluations. Adds a unified baseline matrix harness, records a baseline-first spec, runs a no-LLM Tier-1 smoke on graph_color/sudoku/zebra_puzzles, and records that the LLM one-shot baseline path needs checkpoint/process-timeout before larger LLM baseline runs.

code_added_used.change: Adds a unified Reasoning Gym baseline matrix runner with official_oracle_answer, empty_answer, symbolic heuristic/random for graph_color/sudoku, zebra adapter-pending rows, and optional LLM one-shot arms.
Records the baseline-first program pivot: populate Reasoning Gym baselines before further method comparisons.

commands.purpose: Validate the new baseline matrix runner compiles.
Run no-LLM baseline matrix smoke across Tier-1 Reasoning Gym benchmarks.
Attempt LLM one-shot baseline smoke; stopped after about 300 seconds without artifact, motivating checkpoint/process-timeout for LLM baselines.

headline.single_next_move: Add checkpoint/process-timeout to LLM one-shot baseline runner, then populate L1 one-shot baselines before resuming method comparisons.

gate_outcomes.number: Method tests are paused until Reasoning Gym baseline matrix is built and tested.
official_oracle_answer solve_rate=1.0 for graph_color, sudoku, and zebra_puzzles on n=3 smoke.
empty_answer solve_rate=0.0 for all three benchmarks.
L0-symbolic-heuristic solve_rate=1.0 for graph_color and sudoku; random solve_rate=0.0 under smoke budgets.
Zebra official scoring works, but symbolic heuristic/random rows are adapter-pending.
Tiny LLM one-shot smoke did not produce artifact before manual cutoff; needs checkpoint/process-timeout before full LLM baseline.
Do not resume externalization/multi-agent method comparisons until baseline matrix is populated.

decision.next_step_routing: Implement checkpoint/process-timeout for LLM one-shot baselines in analysis.reasoning_gym_baseline_matrix, rerun L1-one_shot_direct on Tier-1, then extend baselines before method comparisons.

rows.reason: Tiny LLM smoke timed out without artifact.
Need structural parser/adapter before symbolic zebra baselines.
Baseline matrix must be populated first.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not evaluate the externalized M-register or multi-agent method, and it does not claim method superiority. It only creates/smoke-tests the baseline-first harness and records LLM baseline timeout as a blocker.
honesty.llm_limit: LLM one-shot baseline attempt produced no artifact before cutoff; it must be rerun with checkpoint/process-timeout.
honesty.smoke_limit: No-LLM baseline smoke uses n=3 and is a harness/scoring sanity check, not a final benchmark table.
